campaign: Repository-wide literal elimination and single runtime authority
doctrine: Follow skill.md. Current census: 894 production files, 20,081 inline literals, 2,599 assumption hints, 1,228 copied test-policy sites. Audit every non-generated Go file in deterministic scanner order. Process the first exact finding, then consolidate every same-semantic occurrence. Split heterogeneous packages into deletion-led ownership waves; finish each package with one exact closure gate. Classify literals as structural syntax, mathematical fact, protocol/ABI fact, fixture input, derived value, or runtime policy. Artifact facts, RepoDB recipes, compiled plans, and measured resource plans own runtime policy; missing authority fails. Constants may name stable mathematics or wire contracts, never local model policy. Recipes and neutral typed operators are sole runtime authorities. Every new or extended primitive migrates all equivalent callers and deletes displaced model orchestration, wrappers, fallbacks, duplicate probes, compatibility readers, and parallel registries in the same commit. Each implementation wave is production-code net-negative, including untracked Go files. Fixtures define inputs; tests reuse production contracts and shared assertions. Preserve numerical behavior while reducing allocations, transfers, probes, branches, maps, and operations. Run focused tests, the exact wave gate, full host tests, applicable CUDA gates, diff checks, and census publication before the gate commit; merge tightening/master before redispatch. Completion requires zero stale bindings, open derivation-blocked rows, uncatalogued production policy, copied test policy, and model facts outside artifact or recipe authorities.

items.title: Remove model facts and orchestration from runtime code

steps.title: Delete inference family dispatch, duplicate probes, and compatibility sessions
steps.rationale: Compiled recipes must own residency, prefill, decode, cache, and modality admission without parallel direct-open paths.

steps.title: Delete image, video, and speech family policy in favor of neutral media programs
steps.rationale: Media geometry, schedules, codec stages, and publication policy must come from compiled recipes and shared operators.

items.title: Consolidate protocol, quantization, codec, and storage literals

steps.title: Bind GGUF and safetensors literals to typed wire contracts
steps.rationale: Wire values may remain only in one protocol owner; duplicated layout arithmetic must use typed traits.

steps.title: Consolidate quantization and codec arithmetic into shared typed operations
steps.rationale: Block geometry and encoding constants must be specification-owned; runtime policy must be derived.

steps.title: Remove artifact and RepoDB storage policy duplication
steps.rationale: Bounds and layouts require one storage contract instead of repeated command and runtime limits.

steps.title: Consolidate tensor, host, device, CUDA, graph-runtime, and memory policy
steps.rationale: Low-level relations and launch policy require one typed owner before higher runtimes can delete local copies.

steps.title: Delete literals and duplicate orchestration from derived model runtimes
steps.rationale: Derived runtimes must compose compiled recipes and neutral operators without restating shapes, topology, or residency.

steps.title: Derive training and optimizer policy from compiled training plans
steps.rationale: Training literals must derive from model, dataset, optimizer ownership, and measured resource plans.

steps.title: Consolidate tokenizer, dataset, evaluation, and sampling policy
steps.rationale: Dataset and tokenizer facts belong to catalog artifacts; evaluation and sampling policy belongs to typed requests and recipes.

steps.title: Remove server, workflow, session, and protocol policy duplication
steps.rationale: Server and workflow code should compose admitted plans; protocol literals require one wire owner.

steps.title: Consolidate composition, metrics, telemetry, and evidence policy
steps.rationale: Catalog similarity remains a literal filter; metrics and evidence must not introduce hidden distribution, geometry, or threshold policy.

steps.title: Delete duplicated policy across remaining internal runtime owners
steps.rationale: The deterministic census must close every remaining internal package without reworking already closed owners.

steps.title: Delete command defaults, duplicate probes, and automation literals
steps.rationale: Commands compose typed owners; they must not restate runtime, model, training, or gate policy.

steps.title: Verify every production source has an exact literal disposition
steps.rationale: Scoped waves must converge to a fresh repository-wide source census with no uncatalogued decision.

items.title: Remove copied production policy from tests

steps.title: Replace copied defaults, dimensions, tolerances, and exit codes with production contracts
steps.rationale: Tests define inputs and observable expectations; they must not reimplement production policy or algorithms.

steps.title: Resolve every derivation-blocked row and retire stale migration evidence
steps.rationale: The campaign ends only when every runtime decision is derived, replaced, consolidated, or made irrelevant.

steps.title: Integrate zero-debt checks and delete campaign-only compatibility machinery
steps.rationale: Future changes must preserve exact literal ownership without retaining one-time migration paths.
